column1: # The RS 20 recipe (devices/_family/rs20/rs20.build.conf): the Z9X 1.0.9 image (base.sha256) with its platform set on the
# model's own keys (stage/base_signed, devices/g0111/image/sign_x50_base.py), the Z9X family apps built for the model
# (tools/devices/build_apps.sh: the projector app with the model's HIDL table and menu), the Z9X 1.1.0 image files the
# 1.0.9 base lacks, and the model's identity props. Steps of tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS; the stage pass
# (--stage-only) composes and checks the tree, the image pass (--image-only) packs and checks the image. Trial only: no
# updater, no install from the trial, otacerts.zip empty. verify_rs20.py proves every changed file came from the inputs.
# the projector app (the model's HIDL table and menu), AirPlay and the HDMI input app at their Z9X paths; the base's
# odex and vdex are for the 1.0.9 dex, so they go and ART compiles the new apps itself
# Files, screen mirroring (with its permissions) and the on-screen keyboard of every model
# Wi-Fi Direct on the MediaTek supplicant (the base's Wi-Fi APEX with the patched service-wifi.jar, as every model)
# the static overlays (Wi-Fi Direct device type, the package installer look, the framework keys) and the remote layouts
# SystemUI with a right-to-left language (apps/LumenSystemUIOverlay, static RRO, no dex): TvSystemUI's volume panel
# gravity "end" became LEFT and its TV layout lacks the arrow it then rotates, so SystemUI died on every start
# the video player of every model as its published APK with its own key (tools/build/prebuilt.py)
# the Z9X 1.1.0 image files over their 1.0.9 copies: the native UI fifo stub (an RS 20 is not on its list: every command
# is refused, the vendor is never told a mask is up), the sysconfig, the Google add-on reader, the one blobs reader of
# every model with the Z9X settings, the first boot over stock data, the stock volume split
# the HDMI receiver bridge of the signal panel, the power-on sound and the shared boot animation with its sound
# the problem report log helper of every image (apps/core/lumen-report/image, staged for every device by
# tools/build/build.py COMMON_FILES): a root oneshot that hands the report app the scrubbed system log without a dialog
